## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; lint, types, formatting, and build pass
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated; current capabilities distinguished from planned work
- [ ] SwiftBuild-only prose and commit messages; exact technical identifiers and required attribution preserved
- [ ] Verification results distinguish passed, failed and unverified checks
- [ ] No secrets or local research included
- [ ] Backward compatibility and explicit migrations considered
- [ ] UI changes tested with keyboard interaction
- [ ] Significant architecture decisions documented
